The Unlikely Cyclist Saturday Women's Group Ride

Costa Mesa, CA · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

The Unlikely Cyclist Saturday Women's Group Ride is a road group ride in Costa Mesa, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:15 am from The Unlikely Cyclist. Pace: two groups: 15 mph and 12–13 mph average. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @theunlikelycyclist the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Unlikely Cyclist Saturday Women's Group Ride group ride

A women's road ride from a women's bike shop. Two pace groups, no-drop, with a coffee stop and regroups. Distance changes each week. Road bike and helmet required.
